title: Agentic AI Systems: From Plan to Production
description: Design dependable AI agents that plan, use tools, preserve state, recover from failure, and ship behind production APIs. Build a complete research agent with evaluation gates and human oversight.

title: RAG Engineering with Vector Databases
description: Build grounded retrieval systems using embeddings, hybrid search, metadata filters, re-ranking, and rigorous retrieval evaluation. Includes practical Chroma and Qdrant projects.

title: FastAPI Backend Engineering
description: Create typed, secure Python APIs with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, background work, authentication, testing, and deployment patterns that hold up beyond a tutorial.

title: LLM Evaluation That Teams Can Trust
description: Turn subjective AI quality into an evaluation program. Design golden sets, model-graded checks, retrieval metrics, regression suites, and production feedback loops.

title: Practical Prompt Systems
description: Move beyond prompt tricks to reusable prompt architecture: structured outputs, tool contracts, context design, injection defenses, caching, and model portability.

title: Behavioral Product Analytics
description: Instrument useful events, define funnels and cohorts, interpret intent signals, and build privacy-aware product insights without drowning your team in vanity metrics.

title: Recommendation Systems in Practice
description: Learn collaborative, content-based, and hybrid recommendation methods, then add cold-start strategies, ranking, online evaluation, and responsible personalization.

title: Modern SQL for Data Products
description: Use SQL confidently for analytics and application features: window functions, query plans, indexes, data modeling, and reliable transformations through realistic exercises.

title: Production ML Systems
description: Take models from notebook to dependable service with feature pipelines, versioning, monitoring, drift response, safe rollout patterns, and cost-aware infrastructure.

title: Python Foundations Through Real Projects
description: Build fluency with Python syntax, data structures, functions, modules, debugging, and tests by completing four useful applications from scratch.

title: AI UX: Designing Human-Centred Copilots
description: Design AI product experiences that communicate uncertainty, earn trust, support correction, and keep people in control. Prototype a copilot from first interaction to failure recovery.

title: Cloud Deployment for Python Teams
description: Package, deploy, and operate Python services with containers, managed databases, CI/CD, secrets, health checks, logging, and pragmatic scaling choices.

title: Data Analysis with Python and Pandas
description: Turn messy business data into clear answers with Python, pandas, notebooks, joins, reshaping, and reproducible analysis projects.

title: SQL Analytics Interview Lab
description: Practice the SQL patterns data analysts use every day: cohorts, funnels, retention, window functions, segmentation, and business case questions.

title: Storytelling with Data and Dashboards
description: Design decision-ready dashboards, choose meaningful metrics, communicate uncertainty, and present an analytical story leaders can act on.

title: Statistics for Data Scientists
description: Build the statistical intuition behind experiments and machine learning with probability, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and practical case studies.

title: Feature Engineering for Tabular ML
description: Transform real-world tables into reliable machine learning features while preventing leakage, handling missingness, encoding categories, and validating generalization.

title: Experiment Design and Causal Thinking
description: Plan trustworthy product experiments, reason about causality, choose metrics, estimate power, and interpret results without overclaiming.

title: Deep Learning with PyTorch Projects
description: Learn neural network fundamentals by building image, text, and tabular models in PyTorch with training loops, diagnostics, and reproducible experiments.

title: LLM Application Architecture
description: Design production LLM applications with model routing, context management, structured outputs, tool calls, retries, budgets, and human review.

title: Fine-Tuning and Adaptation for Language Models
description: Choose between prompting, retrieval, adapters, and fine-tuning, then prepare datasets and evaluate an adapted language model responsibly.

title: LLM Cost and Latency Optimization
description: Make AI products faster and cheaper with token budgets, caching, batching, model selection, streaming, fallbacks, and practical load tests.

title: Prompt Engineering for Reliable Workflows
description: Create prompts that remain reliable across models using decomposition, examples, constraints, self-checks, structured outputs, and evaluation-driven iteration.

title: Prompt Security and Injection Defense
description: Threat-model LLM applications, defend against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and build safe system prompts with layered controls.

title: Tool-Calling Agents with Python
description: Build tool-using assistants that validate arguments, recover from errors, preserve state, and expose clear traces for debugging and evaluation.

title: Data Pipelines with Airflow
description: Orchestrate dependable batch pipelines with Airflow DAGs, schedules, retries, backfills, data quality checks, and observable task dependencies.

title: Streaming Data with Kafka
description: Design event-driven data platforms with Kafka topics, partitions, consumer groups, delivery semantics, schema evolution, and monitoring.

title: Data Warehousing with dbt
description: Build tested analytical models with dbt, dimensional design, incremental transformations, documentation, lineage, and collaborative deployment workflows.

title: Data Quality and Observability
description: Prevent silent pipeline failures with contracts, freshness checks, anomaly detection, lineage, incident response, and actionable data quality ownership.

title: Kubernetes for AI Engineers
description: Deploy model and agent services on Kubernetes with containers, health checks, autoscaling, secrets, jobs, and practical service debugging.

title: MLOps with CI/CD and Model Registries
description: Automate model testing and delivery with CI/CD, registries, reproducible artifacts, approval gates, deployment strategies, and rollback plans.

title: Monitoring AI Systems in Production
description: Observe AI quality, latency, cost, drift, safety, and user outcomes with useful traces, dashboards, alerts, and feedback loops.

title: AWS Foundations for Data Platforms
description: Understand the AWS building blocks behind modern data products: IAM, storage, compute, networking, managed databases, and cost-aware architecture.

title: Python APIs for AI Products
description: Ship production-ready AI endpoints with FastAPI, async work, streaming responses, authentication, rate limits, validation, and tests.

title: Responsible AI and Model Governance
description: Create practical governance for AI products with risk assessments, documentation, human oversight, privacy controls, and launch review checklists.

title: Analytics Engineering with Modern SQL
description: Bridge analysis and engineering by building modular, tested, documented SQL models that deliver trusted metrics to every team.
